name: Wolfeboro Parks & Recreation Summer Day Camp
description_short: A town-run summer day camp for ages 6 to 12, Monday to Friday from 9am to 3:30pm at the Foss Field Pavilion. Campers are split into two age groups (6 to 8 and 9 to 12), with beach days on Wednesdays and a weekly field trip.
swim_waterfront_notes: Beach days are Wednesdays at Carry Beach (201 Forest Rd.); campers bring a swimsuit and towel.

warnings: This page is for the 2026 season, which is already over (today is 2026-10-13). There is no 2027 information yet, so 2027 prices, dates and registration may be different.
The page does not list session weeks or dates. Camp runs weekly, Monday to Friday, but the start and end dates are not given, so no sessions were recorded.
There are two weekly prices: $95 for residents and $143 for non-residents. price_per_week shows the resident rate.
The street address on the page (84 S Main Street) is the Town of Wolfeboro office, not the camp. Campers sign in at Foss Field Pavilion, and no street address is given for it.
2026 registration opened April 1 for residents and April 15 for non-residents. The 2027 opening dates are not known.
